media.title: Berlin, Potsdamer Platz with Columbushaus — context photograph, 1933
media.description: Photograph of Potsdamer Platz with the Columbushaus in Berlin, taken by Waldemar Titzenthaler in 1933. Used as context for Kaper’s Berlin years.
media.altText: Black-and-white street view of Berlin’s Potsdamer Platz with the Columbushaus building.
media.rightsNote: Public-domain route via Wikimedia Commons. The Commons file identifies Waldemar Titzenthaler as author and marks the image as public domain / Public Domain Mark 1.0; Titzenthaler died in 1937. Use as a Berlin Potsdamer Platz / Columbushaus context image.
